label: Video
when: a video file from the media library, played on the page
rules: Use only a video from "The site's media library" (a "video" line): its exact address as "src" in the HTML and its ID as "id" in the comment, like {"id":2480}. The comment holds only "id"; controls, src, poster and the caption are HTML. Keep "controls"; no autoplay, loop, muted or tracks. A caption is the figcaption after the video. A poster is optional: only an image from the list, as poster="address" between controls and src. If no video is in the list, write no video block.
